title: Japanese Camellia Oil Braised Velvet
description: A delicate Japanese-inspired dish featuring tender velvet braised in rich camellia oil. Perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat camellia oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add sliced ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add tender velvet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sake, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise for 30 minutes, or until the velvet is tender.
Stir in sesame oil and chopped green onions.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
